obligations.source_text: Independently test the assigned karst surface subsurface drainage concept in one complex photorealistic environmental scene, using the supplied portrait only as a general adult appearance reference while keeping the landform and connected water-routing evidence primary and unobstructed.

bindings.karst_rock_phrase: exposed pale jointed solution-weathered rock anchors the drainage landform
bindings.karst_depression_phrase: a bowl or sink-shaped closed depression lacks an ordinary surface outlet
bindings.losing_stream_phrase: a surface stream visibly narrows and enters a sink opening or swallow hole
bindings.resurgence_phrase: a distinct spring or cave-mouth outlet releases water elsewhere in the same landscape as a visible flowing pool
